sloka: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः ।अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ।। ६.५९.५५ ।।।।
transliteration: devadānavagandharvairyakṣaiśca saha rākṣasaiḥ ।avadhyatvaṁ tvayā prāptaṁ vānarebhyastu te bhayam ।। 6.59.55 ।।।।

translations.english: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."
